defect.message: The bridge uses steel plate girders ("Steel plate girders acting compositely with a 0.25 m cast-in-place deck slab... steel girder depth 1.4 m, top flange 400 mm x 25 mm, bottom flange 500 mm x 30 mm, web 1345 mm x 16 mm, steel Q345"). The knowledge graph covers only concrete girder types — its section schemas are small_box, t_girder and cast_box (all prestressed/precast concrete), the section-property rule MR-02 refers to concrete sections with wet joints and diaphragms, and the governing modulus clause JTG3362-3.1.5 is the concrete elastic-modulus table (grade in EC_TABLE). No rule, clause or section geometry exists for a steel plate girder or for a steel-concrete composite section, so the main-girder A, I and Ec cannot be modeled as given. This component falls outside the scope of the knowledge graph.
